name: hero-heatmap
title: Hero Heatmap
description: A split landing hero with a two-line headline, short paragraph, pill button and two tech badges on the left, and a glowing lightning-bolt heatmap on the right. The bolt pulses through blue, green, yellow and magenta.
use: A launch page wants one glowing symbol to carry the hero, with the headline and copy beside it.
avoid: The glow loop never stops and needs WebGL, and the bolt is a data-URI image you have to replace.
a11y: A hidden h1 and a text link serve screen readers, but the pulsing shader has no reduced-motion stop. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: On black, a left column stacks a large white two-line heading, a dim paragraph, an outlined pill button and two bordered badges. The right visual is a lightning-bolt silhouette shown as a heat map, its edges glowing blue, green and yellow around a hot pink core.
behaves: The bolt's heat field breathes, going from a faint blue outline to a full rainbow flare and back within a few seconds. The text and buttons hold still; hover lifts the button and badges, and on small screens the glow becomes a band under the copy.
customise: Text, CTA and badges are props, and the heatmap accepts its image, colour ramp, contour, glow and speed. Layout and glow placement are class edits.
weight: heavy: A heatmap WebGL shader glows continuously across half the hero.
